data.summary:
Over 8 years of experience as a Data Scientist, with a strong focus on delivering scalable AI, ML, and analytics solutions across industries using Python.
Currently leading product development at Accure INC for client Include (PWC), working on a Generative AI-based platform focused on loyalty program optimization and retail analytics, leveraging large-scale LLMs and domain-specific insights.
Designed and implemented LLM-based chat systems with extended context handling up to 1M tokens, utilizing cutting-edge LLaMA 4 architecture to support complex user interactions and multi-turn conversations.
Played a lead role in building AccureIQ, an enterprise AI analytics platform designed for rapid, intelligent decision-making across business units.
Designed and led the development of robust AI architectures across diverse domains including Education, Solar, Legal, and Jobs/HR, delivering solutions such as adaptive learning systems, predictive maintenance, contract intelligence, and recruitment analytics.
Oversaw the full AI product lifecycle—from gathering domain-specific requirements and defining technology stacks to leading development, testing, deployment, and ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability of systems in production.
Developed Agentic AI solutions tailored for Contracts and Compliance, enabling autonomous reasoning, context tracking, and real-time responses in legal and regulatory environments.
Directed Descriptive, Diagnostic, Predictive, Prescriptive Analytics, solution development using Advanced Analytics & AI/ML techniques on Big Data Stack by leading the team of 6 professionals
Rendered business consulting across Analytics & BPR encompassing definition of analytics roadmap, set-up of analytics COE/KPOS
Demonstrating proficiency in cutting-edge machine learning models, NLP, deep learning techniques, and collaborating with stakeholders to develop strategic roadmaps while leveraging advanced querying and visualization tools for complex data analysis
Achieved a remarkable 157% increase in revenue through data analysis and visualization in the current role
Developed innovative business solutions to improve revenue, quality and product performance and reduce cost by leveraging combination of domain knowledge, Data Science & Data Engineering skills
Hands-on experience in advanced analytical practices such as predictive analysis, attribution modelling and customer profiling
Exhibiting strong leadership skills by mentoring junior data scientists and fostering a collaborative and growth-focused team culture

Professional Experience:
Accure Inc. Jun 2024 –Aug 2025 Senior Data Scientist
Project: Incluud (PWC) Jun 2024 – Aug 2025
 Developing a large-scale Generative AI platform to optimize loyalty programs and retail customer engagement using LLMs with extended context windows (up to 1M tokens, LLaMA 4). Designed AccureIQ, a centralized AI analytics platform enabling enterprise-wide intelligent decision-making.
Responsibilities:
Spearheaded the development of Python-based Generative AI platforms for loyalty optimization and retail analytics, driving intelligent customer engagement solutions.
Spearheaded the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI products, driving innovation and scalability across client use cases.
Delivered domain-specific Generative AI solutions using large-scale language models, enabling intelligent automation in loyalty programs and retail analytics.
Designed and implemented advanced chat systems with context windows up to 1 million tokens, using LLaMA 4 architecture for high-context, multi-turn interactions.
Led product development for client Include, aligning AI-driven solutions with business goals in the retail and customer engagement domains.
Played a pivotal role in architecting and launching AccureIQ, a centralized enterprise AI platform to support strategic decision-making across departments.
Developed Agentic AI solutions for Contract Intelligence and Compliance, integrating autonomous agents capable of reasoning over legal texts and regulatory content.
Focused on building AI solutions with a strong emphasis on performance, reliability, and scalability for real-world deployment.
Bridged business needs with technical design by collaborating closely with stakeholders to create tailored, high-impact AI tools and systems.
Environment/Tools: Python, TensorFlow, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, GCP, Superset, SQL, Git
Vinove Software and Services Oct 2023 – Jun 2024 Data Scientist
Project: Suntropy Oct 2023 – Jun 2024
Developed Suntropy, an LLM-driven platform for automated product and pricing quotation generation in the solar industry. The system parsed customer installation requirements and intelligently selected pre-defined templates, dynamically placing solar components to generate polished quotation documents — eliminating the need for manual drafting by content writers.
Responsibilities: 
Designed and implemented an LLM-based decision engine using OpenAI APIs, mapping customer specifications to optimal product/installation templates.
Automated quotation workflows, reducing manual effort by 80%+ and accelerating client delivery timelines.
Developed a cognitive placement system for solar components, ensuring technical accuracy with visually structured business documents.
Integrated pricing logic, business rules, and content styling directly into the AI pipeline for consistency across client outputs.
Deployed the platform on AWS cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
Built APIs and services with FastAPI, enabling seamless integration with client-facing systems.
Environment/Tools: Python, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, FastAPI, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), SQL, Git
Moreyeahs Inc., Indore Oct 2021 – Oct 2023 Data Scientist
Project: TTEC Digital -  Google CCAI Product Development, GCS & Looker Apr 2023 – Oct 2023
Worked on Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI) product development, enhancing customer experience platforms through NLP, automated pipelines, and advanced analytics dashboards. The project focused on speech-to-text, sentiment analysis, and intelligent reporting to support enterprise clients in scaling customer engagement solutions. 
Responsibilities: 
Developed and optimized a Python-based automated ML deployment pipeline, cutting deployment time from weeks to minutes.
Built and fine-tuned NLP models for sentiment classification, achieving 93% accuracy in real-world customer interactions.
Designed real-time analytics dashboards in Looker, enabling business teams to track KPIs and customer sentiment at scale.
Led the integration of ML models with Google Cloud infrastructure (GCS, BigQuery) for production-grade deployment.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven insights that contributed to a 157% increase in revenue for client accounts.
Improved system reliability and maintainability through pipeline automation and version-controlled deployments.
Environment/Tools: Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, GCP (GCS, BigQuery, Vertex AI), Looker, Airflow, Git, SQL
Project: CHEQ-One - Data Extraction Pipeline from Credit Card Statements Aug 2022 – Mar 2023
Developed CHEQ-One, an automated data extraction and processing pipeline for financial data sourced from credit card statements. The system streamlined ingestion, parsing, and transformation of unstructured financial data into structured, analytics-ready formats, enabling real-time insights and compliance reporting. 
Responsibilities: 
Built end-to-end automated pipelines for extracting, validating, and transforming credit card statement data, reducing processing time by 40%.
Developed and refined NLP and pattern recognition algorithms to accurately parse semi-structured statements with varying formats.
Enhanced sentiment and behavior analysis algorithms, achieving 33% improvement in accuracy for customer insights.
Designed and trained deep learning models for object/document recognition, achieving 96% accuracy in entity extraction.
Collaborated with stakeholders to prioritize roadmap features, ensuring technical deliverables aligned with compliance and business needs.
Implemented monitoring and logging frameworks to ensure pipeline reliability and auditability in financial environments.
Environment/Tools: Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage), SQL, Airflow, Git, OCR APIs
Project: BEGIG – Content - Based Recommendation System & Resume Parser (Tech- Mahindra) Oct 2021 – Jul 2022
Developed BEGIG, an AI-powered talent intelligence platform featuring a content-based recommendation system and an automated resume parser. The solution enabled recruiters to match candidates with job opportunities more effectively by leveraging NLP-driven skill extraction, semantic similarity, and recommendation algorithms. 
Responsibilities: 
Designed and deployed a content-based recommendation system that matched candidates to jobs using embeddings and similarity scoring.
Developed an automated resume parser using NLP techniques, extracting structured data (skills, education, experience) from unstructured resumes with high accuracy.
Built A/B testing frameworks to evaluate recommendation quality and continuously improve matching precision.
Delivered complex data analyses and visualizations, enabling recruiters and hiring managers to make data-driven hiring decisions.
Collaborated with product managers and stakeholders to integrate resume parsing + recommendations into client-facing applications.
Mentored junior data scientists on data mining, SAS, and NLP techniques, fostering knowledge-sharing across the team.
Environment/Tools: Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, SpaCy, NLTK, SQL, Airflow, Git, Superset
D2K Technologies Oct 2020 – Oct 2021 Machine Learning Engineer
Project: Credit Risk Analysis  for Tamil Nadu Mercantile Bank Oct 2020 – Oct 2021
Developed and deployed a credit risk analytics solution for Tamil Nadu Mercantile Bank to evaluate customer creditworthiness and estimate loan default probabilities. The system enabled the bank to make data-driven lending decisions, reduce risk exposure, and improve loan portfolio management.
Responsibilities: 
Performed large-scale Python-based data conversions for integration into a financial customer Drawing Power Estimator.
Enhanced data quality through data cleansing methods
Contributed to internal activities for process improvements and innovation
Prepared written summaries and maintained documentation
Designed and developed analytical data structures.Built predictive ML models for credit risk scoring using customer financial data, improving risk classification accuracy.
Conducted large-scale data conversion and cleansing pipelines in Python to integrate legacy financial data into analytics workflows.
Designed and implemented analytical data structures to support real-time risk evaluation and regulatory compliance reporting.
Enhanced model transparency by applying explainable AI techniques (feature importance, SHAP values) for compliance with financial audit requirements.
Collaborated with banking stakeholders to define KPIs and decision thresholds, aligning technical models with business risk policies.
Maintained detailed documentation and prepared written summaries for risk assessment methodologies.
Environment/Tools: Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, SQL, Excel, Git, Jupyter
FlipRobo Dec 2019 – Oct 2020 Machine Learning Engineer
Project: Smart Attendance System May 2020 – Oct 2020
Developed a computer vision–based smart attendance system to automate employee/student check-ins through facial recognition. The solution replaced manual attendance marking with an AI-driven approach, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in real-world environments.
Responsibilities: 
Built and deployed facial recognition models using deep learning, achieving high accuracy across diverse lighting/angle conditions.
Engineered a real-time camera integration pipeline, enabling seamless attendance tracking with minimal latency.
Designed a secure database integration layer to log attendance records and sync with enterprise HR systems.
Implemented liveness detection techniques to prevent spoofing and ensure authenticity.
Deployed the system on local servers for fast inference and reliability.
Environment/Tools: Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow/Keras, SQL, FastAPI, Git 
Project: Number Plate Recognition System for Smart Cities Dec 2019 – Apr 2020
Developed an automated number plate recognition (ANPR) system for smart city infrastructure to track vehicles in real time, enabling use cases such as traffic management, toll collection, and security monitoring.
Responsibilities: 
Designed and implemented OCR-based deep learning models to detect and recognize number plates with high precision.
Processed real-time video streams from CCTV/traffic cameras, optimizing pipelines for low-latency inference.
Built preprocessing modules for plate localization, noise reduction, and character segmentation.
Integrated recognition output with traffic databases for vehicle identification and rule enforcement.
Improved recognition accuracy across diverse plate formats and environments (day/night, blurred images).
Environment/Tools: Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow/Keras, Tesseract OCR, SQL, Git
Codenscious, Indore Feb 2018 – Nov 2019 Machine Learning Engineer
Project: Smart Supermart Cams to Detect Suspicious Activities and Customer Behavior Apr 2019 – Nov 2019
Developed an AI-powered surveillance system for retail supermarkets to detect suspicious activities and analyze customer behavior patterns using CCTV feeds. The system enhanced store security and provided insights into customer engagement. 
Responsibilities: 
Built object detection and behavior recognition models to identify suspicious activity (e.g., loitering, shoplifting).
Applied pose estimation and motion tracking to analyze in-store customer movement and dwell time.
Designed pipelines for real-time video analysis and anomaly detection using deep learning models.
Delivered actionable insights to improve store security and customer experience optimization.
Deployed system on local GPU servers for low-latency, on-premise video analytics.
Environment/Tools: Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow/Keras, YOLO, SQL, Git
Project: Pedestrian Rush Hour Analysis using People Tracking Algorithm Sep 2018 – Mar 2019
Implemented a people tracking system to analyze pedestrian flow during rush hours for urban planning and crowd management. 
Responsibilities: 
Designed multi-object tracking algorithms for pedestrian detection and trajectory prediction.
Analyzed rush hour patterns to generate insights for infrastructure planning and safety monitoring.
Created heatmaps and flow visualizations to represent pedestrian density and movement trends.
Optimized real-time video pipelines for large-scale surveillance environments.
Environment/Tools: Python, OpenCV, DeepSORT, TensorFlow, SQL, Matplotlib
Project: Data Collection and Labelling for Pose Estimation Project Feb 2018 – Aug 2018
Contributed to a pose estimation project by building datasets and preparing labeled data for human activity recognition models.
Responsibilities: 
Collected and annotated large-scale datasets for human pose estimation tasks.
Applied labeling techniques for keypoints (joints, limbs) to train supervised learning models.
Collaborated with model developers to validate dataset quality and improve accuracy.
Ensured dataset consistency and robustness across diverse human activities and environments.
Environment/Tools: Python, OpenCV, LabelImg, COCO Keypoint Format, Git
Pratibha Global Telecom Services (Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited), Indore Jul 2015 – Feb 2018 RF Engineer
Project: Jio 4G Drive Testing Jul 2015 – Feb 2018
Worked as part of the Reliance Jio 4G network deployment team, conducting RF drive testing, data collection, and performance optimization to ensure high-quality mobile connectivity during the launch and expansion of Jio’s 4G services across regions.
Responsibilities: 
Performed extensive RF drive testing to validate network coverage, call quality, and handover performance.
Collected and analyzed network KPIs (RSRP, SINR, Throughput) to assess service quality and optimize performance.
Used specialized telecom tools to map coverage gaps, dropped calls, and signal strengths.
Collaborated with senior RF engineers to implement parameter tuning and cell optimization strategies.
Prepared technical reports summarizing test findings and provided recommendations for coverage improvements.
Contributed to the successful rollout and scaling of Jio’s 4G network, supporting millions of users.
Environment/Tools: TEMS Investigation, QXDM, MapInfo, Excel, SQL, XCAL
